experiment_data.hypothesis: 在 directed asymmetric + prevalence-imbalanced DGP 下，oracle/full-truth subgroup confusion correction 应接近恢复 true-group CATE；若 oracle 明显优于 B=500 estimated correction，则后续方法改进应聚焦 confusion estimation / label allocation，而非否定 EC-HTE 校正路径。

spec.data_path: synthetic generated in script using directed_asym_prevalence_v1
spec.data_count: N=5000, reps=300, B=500 estimated arm plus oracle/full-truth arms
spec.device: CPU-only; CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES empty; do not use cuda:0
spec.dgp_ref: Same directed asymmetric/prevalence-imbalanced DGP as stress_global_worse_region_001 revision C006_directed_asymmetric_prevalence_v1
spec.oracle_policy: Oracle/full-truth confusion is diagnostic upper-bound only; report separately from B=500 estimated confusion and never mix with main-method result.
spec.pass_fail: Pass if oracle subgroup/global and B=500 estimated results are separately reported under the directed DGP and the upper-bound gap is quantified; fail if oracle is mixed into the main result or DGP lacks asymmetric/prevalence/directed-flow checks.
